`tests/test_cli_disclaimer.py` has 16 tests. Right now 11 fail and 5 pass. Every failure is the missing disclaimer or the missing README section, which is what you want from an oracle. No other file was touched.

- `test_config_disclaimer_is_the_spec_text`: pins both `config.DISCLAIMER` locales to the exact SPEC §9.4 FR and EN text.
- `test_print_review_prints_the_fixed_disclaimer_once_and_last`: `_print_review` prints the `config` fr-CA text exactly once, as the last line, like `check` (§1 inv. 7, §9.4).
- `test_print_review_follows_the_report_locale`: with an en-CA report it prints the EN text and not the FR text.
  - SPEC-AMBIGUITY: I took the stricter reading, because §9.4 gives both languages.
- `test_print_review_keeps_its_existing_lines`: adding the disclaimer must not drop the verdict, sections, "cannot verify" line, run_id or profile line (§12).
- `test_print_review_does_not_retype_the_disclaimer`: the function source holds no literal disclaimer words and refers to the disclaimer, so the text comes from config (CLAUDE.md, §9.4).
- `test_cli_review_command_prints_the_disclaimer`: `cli.main(["review", fixtures/robert])` offline in mock mode, in a temp cwd on a fixture copy, prints the fr-CA disclaimer as its last line (§12).
- `test_cli_review_output_describes_and_never_prescribes`: the review output has no advisory phrases (D10, §1 inv. 7).
- `test_demo_still_prints_the_disclaimer`: regression check that `demo` still ends with the disclaimer.
- `test_readme_has_a_known_limitations_section_with_a_body`: README needs a "Known limitations" heading with a body of more than 400 characters (§19).
- `test_readme_limitation_window_bootstrap_and_assumed_drift`: the section mentions the 5-year window, block bootstrap, drift, ASSUMED and "forecast" (§19 bullet 1).
- `test_readme_limitation_survivorship_bias`: the section mentions survivorship bias (§19 bullet 2).
- `test_readme_limitation_lookthrough_unknowns_and_what_it_covers_now`: the section says sector, employer and activity checks on ETFs are unknown without look-through (§19 bullet 3). It must also say what look-through covers now: `etf_sector_weights`, H6, H10, and H11 staying unknown without an `activity_tags` row.
- `test_readme_limitation_behaviour_classification`: the section says classification is noisy, confidence is capped at 0.8, it needs at least 2 events, and it is a warning that never blocks (§19 bullet 4).
- `test_readme_limitation_amf_ciro_kyc_out_of_scope`: the section says the limits are team calibrations, not regulation, and that AMF/CIRO KYC suitability is out of scope (§19 bullet 5, matching the UI note in `deploy/site/index.html`).
